step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates MagellanTV's automated documentary content localization pipeline on AWS. Video content uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket is split into speaker files and processed by Amazon Translate. The text then flows through a three-stage Amazon Bedrock pipeline (Idiom/Slang Detection, Sentence Shortening, and Cultural Sensitivity Checks). Next, the refined script is passed to Amazon Polly for text-to-speech generation, followed by Amazon Augmented AI (A2I) for human-in-the-loop quality checks. Finally, localized video, audio, and caption files are saved into a destination S3 bucket. AWS Step Functions orchestrates the data pipeline, while AWS CloudFormation provisions multi-node scaling environments generated via CDK.

graph.name: MagellanTV Content Localization Architecture
graph.categories: Data & Analytics, Machine Learning & AI, Media & Localization
graph.notes: Automates video content localization from $20/min down to ~$1/min using generative AI (Bedrock), translation, speech synthesis (Polly), and human review (A2I).

nodes.name: Amazon S3 (Input)
nodes.notes: Ingests raw documentary files and splits them into speaker-specific JSON chunks.

nodes.name: Amazon Translate
nodes.notes: Translates speaker transcript files across target languages.

nodes.name: Amazon Bedrock (Idiom)
nodes.notes: Detects and translates idioms and slang (English-to-English adaptation).

nodes.name: Amazon Bedrock (Sentence Shortening)
nodes.notes: Shortens localized text to fit strict video timing and dubbing windows.

nodes.name: Amazon Bedrock (Cultural)
nodes.notes: Checks script for regional grammar nuances and cultural sensitivities.

nodes.name: Amazon Polly
nodes.notes: Converts localized text scripts into speech audio files.

nodes.name: Amazon Augmented AI
nodes.notes: Provides human translators a platform for spot-checking and quality assurance.

nodes.name: Amazon S3 (Output)
nodes.notes: Stores final localized output files including video, audio, and captions.

nodes.name: AWS Step Functions
nodes.notes: Orchestrates data movement and execution steps across all pipeline services.

nodes.name: AWS CloudFormation
nodes.notes: Deploys CDK infrastructure stacks to spin up parallel processing nodes.

edges.notes: Speaker JSON files sent from input S3 bucket to Amazon Translate.
Translated text sent to Amazon Bedrock for idiom detection.
Idiom-adapted text sent to Amazon Bedrock for sentence shortening.
Shortened text passed to Amazon Bedrock for cultural sensitivity review.
Final localized script passed to Amazon Polly for text-to-speech generation.
Generated speech audio files passed to Amazon Augmented AI for human quality check.
Approved video, audio, and caption files written to destination S3 bucket.
AWS Step Functions triggers and orchestrates execution sequence across pipeline.
CloudFormation provisions batch computing nodes for Step Functions orchestration.
